offerings.heading: Spas you can sit in, <mark>then have delivered.</mark>
items: Artesian and Bullfrog spas on the floor in Exton and Huntingdon Valley, so you sit before you buy.
In-house delivery, because a spa that arrives on someone else's truck is how the install goes wrong.
Repairs and service after the sale, from the same company that sold the tub.

story.heading: Two showrooms, one spa shop
paragraphs: Southampton Hot Tub runs Exton and Huntingdon Valley. You can sit in an Artesian or a Bullfrog before anyone talks delivery.
In-house delivery and repairs are the after. Call (215) 791-6170 when you want the consultation, not a brochure.

experience.heading: How a spa buy should go.
items: Sit in the tub at Exton or Huntingdon Valley. Size is a body question.
Ask about in-house delivery so the crane and the pad are theirs.
When something fails later, the repair number is the same shop.

feature.heading: In-house delivery is the difference
feature.text: A spa is a machine you sit in. If a third party drops it, you own the problem. Southampton keeps delivery and repairs inside the company.

contact.heading: Pick a <mark>showroom.</mark>
contact.sub: Exton and Huntingdon Valley. Confirm hours on the official site before you drive.
